people.name: Leah
people.title: Founder & Voice of InnerBoard
people.mission: Teach. Be the voice. Everything else is someone else's job.
owns: The teaching: the practice, the masterclasses and the podcast's point of view
One weekly Recording Block (about half a day, directed by Clint): 1–2 Becoming You episodes, 7 Rep of the Day videos (30–60 sec each), and any promo or offer videos
One monthly masterclass
One short live session a week in the community group (optional but powerful)
The monthly theme, shaped with Abra at the first-Monday theme talk
people.invitation: Protect the teaching. Give the team one focused Recording Block a week, and trust them with everything that happens after it.

people.name: Abra
people.title: Brand and Mission Director
people.mission: Holds the InnerBoard standard and carries it into every room she walks into.
owns: The standard: the Baseline, the Constitution and the shared words. Every name, line and offer traces back to her
Teaching the standard so it travels, and bringing her eye to what is new
Boiling every offer, page and program down to its simplest, most potent form before it ships
The doctrine: everything conceptual in the curriculum, and INQ as Certification Director
The monthly theme, shaped with Leah at the first-Monday theme talk
The signature talk: what InnerBoard is, why it matters, and the invitation into the Practice
Stepping into rooms: groups, organizations, conferences, coaches, schools and communities. She travels and speaks
Programs built on top of the offer for the people in those rooms
Chief of staff: the team's go-to for direction, connection and support
IOS Certification and INQ office hours, and relationships with members, clients and partners
people.invitation: The TED talk is the big, hairy dream: to become so good at what she says, and so brave about how she says it, that she steps onto that stage and gives it everything. Every talk before it is practice for that one.

people.name: Michelle
people.title: COO & Head of Member Experience
people.mission: Owns the member, client and student experience from start to finish, so Practice becomes the place people never want to miss.
owns: The member journey: first welcome, onboarding, the welcome-back message, and every touchpoint that brings people back
Member experience on the Practice app and GHL, with the website as the front door. Skool retires in January 2027
The monthly drop with Logan: the recording, workbook, audio note and surprise drop reaching members clearly
Community: the Practice app and the Labs, alive and personal
Monthly social content for the Practice socials, for now, until Clint is ready to take it on
Operations rhythm: newsletters, Masterclass invites and the daily calendar that keeps it all moving
Supporting Abra's personal social account, so her connections find InnerBoard and Practice
people.invitation: Grow into a lead: build and mentor a team of her own, starting with the person who takes over the tasks she does today. Stretch into YouTube, posting her own reps, and reading the member numbers with Clint.
stop: Writing status reports. The scorecard replaces both.

people.name: Clint
people.title: Creative Director
people.mission: Make InnerBoard look and sound unmistakable everywhere, and turn the founder's weekly recording into a week of content.
people.number: Content shipped per week → group joins
owns: Brand guidelines: one page on colors, fonts, logo use, caption style and voice. Once it exists, routine content goes out without approval
The Recording Block: plans the shot list, sets up, and directs the founder
Podcast production: edits, publishes, cuts 3–5 clips per episode, uploads to YouTube
Rep of the Day: produces and schedules the daily posts 2 weeks ahead
Social: clips, carousels, posting and engagement on our pages
Merch: designs the hat and sweatshirt, runs photo and video shoots in the gear
people.invitation: Own the creative calls: what gets clipped, how it looks, what we try next. Host a short behind-the-scenes series ("how we make InnerBoard"). A director, not an editor.
stop: Waiting for approval on routine posts

people.name: Logan
people.title: App Lead
people.mission: The app is where the practice lives. It works, and everything is in it on time.
people.number: Assets live on time; app issues open
owns: Uploads of replays, audio drops, workbooks and Rep of the Day videos
App onboarding screens and the first-7-days flow, built with Michelle
Gift codes and annual plans: the app can sell a gifted year and flags annual sign-ups for the free hat
App numbers for the scorecard each week: active members, sign-ups, annual vs. monthly
The monthly drop with Michelle
Member data: what the app can report
people.invitation: Be the person who knows the app inside out, so every asset is live and checked on phone and desktop before anyone has to ask.

tasks.title: Announce the new titles and roles to the team
tasks.notes: Everyone reads their card on the Team page and pushes back on anything that feels wrong.

tasks.title: Set the target date for 1,000 members
tasks.notes:
With Abra. The plan assumes 12 months (Nov 30, 2027): about 84 new members a month, or 20 a week. A shorter deadline means a bigger weekly number.
Set: 1,000 people practicing by Nov 9, 2027, with milestones (from Michelle's win sheet).

tasks.title: Decide: is the Rep of the Day group free or members-only?
tasks.notes:
With Abra. Recommendation: free. The group is the front door; the app is where people go deeper.
Open question: Michelle's role puts community in the Practice app and the Labs, and Skool is retiring. Decide whether this lives on Facebook or in the app.

tasks.title: Record our baseline numbers in the scorecard
tasks.notes: With Logan. Michelle owns the member numbers now; pull baselines for the new scorecard.

tasks.title: Confirm the annual price and check the hat economics
tasks.notes: Total cost per hat should be under about 15% of the annual price. See Gift the Practice in the Library.

tasks.title: Confirm the app can sell annual plans and gift codes
tasks.notes: It also needs to flag annual sign-ups so we know who gets a hat.

tasks.title: Order hat samples from 2–3 vendors
tasks.notes: With Michelle. Clint owns the design, Michelle the vendors. Samples needed now to order in bulk by Nov 20.

tasks.title: Book a protected weekly Recording Block
tasks.notes: With Clint. Tuesdays, about half a day. Abra guards it on the calendar.

tasks.title: First Recording Block: 2 podcast episodes and 14 Rep of the Day videos
tasks.notes: With Clint. Clint plans the shot list and directs. Wear the gear if samples have arrived.

tasks.title: Create the Rep of the Day Facebook group
tasks.notes:
Rules, entry questions (including email) and a welcome post. See Rep of the Day in the Library.
Open question: Michelle's role puts community in the Practice app and the Labs, and Skool is retiring. Decide whether this lives on Facebook or in the app.

tasks.title: Write the one-page brand guidelines
tasks.notes: Colors, fonts, logo use, caption style and voice. Once it exists, routine posts go out without approval.

tasks.title: Place the bulk hat order (team gets hats and sweatshirts first)
tasks.notes: Hard deadline: hats take 2–4 weeks. Start with about 100–150. If we miss it, run Gift the Practice as "hat ships in January" and say so up front.

tasks.title: Add one call to action to every podcast episode
tasks.notes: With Abra. Default: "Join the free Rep of the Day group."

tasks.title: Soft-launch the group to current members and podcast listeners
tasks.notes:
With Clint.
Open question: Michelle's role puts community in the Practice app and the Labs, and Skool is retiring. Decide whether this lives on Facebook or in the app.

tasks.title: Pitch the founder to 10 podcasts for January and February
tasks.notes: Guest spots are the highest-leverage reach for a lean team. Aim for 2–4 a month.

tasks.title: Create a free lead magnet for email capture
tasks.notes: Promised in the group entry questions along with the 30-Day Rep Challenge. The email list is the audience we own.

tasks.title: Team photo and video shoot in the gear
tasks.notes: This content feeds December and January. Use the samples if the bulk order has not arrived.

tasks.title: Build 7-day onboarding for new members (in the app and by email)
tasks.notes: With Logan. Welcome, first rep, how to use the app, invitation to the group.

tasks.title: Launch Gift a Year: buy the practice for someone, they get a welcome hat
tasks.notes: With Logan (gift codes) and Clint (creative). Podcast call to action for December: "Gift the practice to someone you love."

tasks.title: Team wears the gear in every video, live session and podcast clip
tasks.notes: Everyone. Clint checks it in every shoot.

tasks.title: Ship hats in one weekly batch
tasks.notes: Every Thursday through December. Keep the count of hats owed and shipped in these notes.

tasks.title: Start the weekly founder live session in the group (15–20 min)
tasks.notes: With Clint and Michelle. Fridays. Daily Rep of the Day continues.

tasks.title: December masterclass: "Becoming You in the New Year"
tasks.notes: Michelle runs production. Follow the masterclass pipeline; kick off at Day −7 (Dec 8).

tasks.title: Launch the Founding 1,000 offer: join annually, get a free hat
tasks.notes: Limited to the first 1,000 annual members. Fine print: one per member, shipping region, ship time. Podcast call to action for January.

tasks.title: Start the 30-Day Rep Challenge in the free group
tasks.notes:
With Clint (daily content). The big front-door push for the year.
Open question: Michelle's role puts community in the Practice app and the Labs, and Skool is retiring. Decide whether this lives on Facebook or in the app.

tasks.title: Invite everyone in the challenge to the January masterclass
tasks.notes: Michelle owns Masterclass invites.

tasks.title: Founder guest podcast appearances begin
tasks.notes: From the pitches sent in November. Target 2–4 a month.

tasks.title: Repost member photos in their hats
tasks.notes: Ongoing through January. Members in the gear are walking invitations.

tasks.title: Launch the "bring a friend" referral program
Start streak rewards: 100 reps earns a sweatshirt
tasks.notes: Tracked by hand at first (members post "Day 100"). Shout-outs at 7, 30 and 100.

tasks.title: Make the monthly masterclass engine run on its own
tasks.notes: Every step of the pipeline has a date and a name, with no reminders needed.

tasks.title: Launch the monthly Member Spotlight podcast segment
tasks.notes: A member's story of becoming. Michelle hosts or co-hosts.

tasks.title: Run the 30- and 90-day retention check and fix the biggest drop-off
tasks.notes: With Logan.

tasks.title: Quarterly review: are we on pace for 1,000?
tasks.notes: Compare the scorecard with the first milestone (250 people practicing by Mar 31) and adjust the plan.

tasks.title: Social handoff: tell Abra what you need to run her personal social account
tasks.notes: So her connections find their way to InnerBoard and Practice.

tasks.title: Turn my responsibilities into a daily and weekly calendar
tasks.notes: A first draft is on the Team page under Our week. Adjust it until it fits.

tasks.title: Bring a shortlist of daily return ideas to the team meeting
tasks.notes: Ideas that make Practice the place people open every day, with a plan to test the top ones.

tasks.title: Welcome-back message, first version live
tasks.notes: Picks people up right where they are. Live in the app and sent through GHL, triggered when someone goes quiet. Needs the welcome-back brief first.

tasks.title: December social content plan written and approved
tasks.notes: Written, planned and approved ahead of time. Then a clear handoff process for Clint when he's ready.

tasks.title: December monthly drop reaches members
tasks.notes: Recording, workbook, audio note and surprise drop, with Logan. Build it as the repeatable checklist in Library → Monthly drop.

tasks.title: Move every member off Skool
tasks.notes: To the Practice app, website and GHL, with clear next steps and no one left behind. Skool closes in January 2027.

tasks.title: Write the role for the first person who joins my team
tasks.notes: Then help hire them and mentor them into the tasks I hold today.

tasks.title: YouTube optimization alongside Clint's refresh
tasks.notes:
Guide: the social media optimization offer Leah received on Loom.
- Channel look and feel that matches the brand
- Thumbnails on new and existing videos
- Captions, titles and descriptions that get found and clicked
- Shorts from the podcast, each linked to its full episode

tasks.title: Post my Practice reps publicly
tasks.notes: Share my reps on social, not just behind the scenes for clients.

tasks.title: Learn to read the member numbers with Clint
tasks.notes: Track who comes back and who drifts away, and decide from the data instead of gut feel.

tasks.title: Map the full member journey, first click to daily habit
tasks.notes: Find where people fall off before they tell us.

tasks.title: Give Michelle access to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
tasks.notes: Dates are starting suggestions.

tasks.title: Build Michelle's support plan together
tasks.notes: With Michelle. Dates are starting suggestions.

tasks.title: Write the welcome-back message brief
tasks.notes: Owner is a best guess; reassign if Leah writes it. Michelle needs it for the first version by end of November. Dates are starting suggestions.

tasks.title: Tell Michelle which member numbers the app, website and GHL can report today
tasks.notes: And which ones need your help to track. Dates are starting suggestions.

tasks.title: Skool move: plan and timeline
tasks.notes: With Michelle and Logan. Owner is a best guess as chief of staff; reassign if needed. Dates are starting suggestions.

tasks.title: Draft the signature talk
tasks.notes: What InnerBoard is, why it matters, and the invitation into the Practice.

tasks.title: List the rooms to step into this quarter
tasks.notes: Groups, organizations, conferences, coaches, schools and communities.

tasks.title: Put the Baseline, Constitution and shared words in the Library
tasks.notes: So the team can apply the standard with confidence.

tasks.title: Set INQ and IOS Certification office hours on the team calendar
